_comment: This file tells Hamilton which concepts to REMOVE when generating Mains and EAMCET syllabi from the JEE Advanced master. Path format: Chapter::Subtopic::Concept
_note_mains: Concepts removed for JEE Mains are considered too advanced / proof-heavy / out of NTA Mains official scope.
_note_eamcet: EAMCET removals are applied ON TOP of Mains removals — EAMCET is a subset of Mains.
